newsitem.title: USA: Vastar has Ship Shoal natgas finds.
newsitem.headline: Vastar has Ship Shoal natgas finds.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said Friday it has interests in two adjacent offshore natural gas discoveries on Ship Shoal Block 126 and Ship Shoal Block 105, located about 25 miles offshore Louisiana.

It said the Ship Shoal 126 1 well was drilled to a depth of 17,000 feet and logged about 126 feet of net pay in three separate pay zones. A second successful well, the Ship Shoal 126 2, was drilled to further delineate the discovery. Both wells are 100 percent owned by Vastar.

The Ship Shoal 105 4 well was drilled to a depth of 16,000 feet and logged over 100 feet of net pay in at least five separate pay zones. Vastar has a 42 percent working interest in this well with the remaining 58 percent owned by Union Pacific Resources Group Inc.
Future plans for the area include additional drilling with production for the complex expected to be onstream around year-end 1997 or early 1998.
Last week Union Pacific said it would spend up to $25 million in the area this year to develop the find.
